label: Wardrobe
depicts: Wardrobe body with one left stack of panels and one tall right door
use_when: Use when the interface wants the wardrobe to mix shelf style panels on one side with one tall door on the other.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two door wardrobe when both sides should stay full height doors with matching dots.

label: Watch
depicts: Round watch face inside one tall body with straight strap blocks attached above and below
use_when: Use when the interface wants the watch to read as one tall body with the face enclosed by straight strap blocks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the watch with separate tabs when the face should not float between detached top and bottom pieces.

label: Watch
depicts: Round watch face with one separate top tab and one separate bottom tab outside the circle
use_when: Use when the interface wants the watch to show more distinct tabs above and below the round face.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tall body watch when the face should not be enclosed inside one continuous case body.

label: Wineglass
depicts: Wine glass with one rounded bowl on a thin stem above one short base line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic rounded wine glass bowl on a stem.
avoid_when: Do not use for the martini glass when the bowl should not sharpen into one wide V shape.

label: Wineglass
depicts: Wine glass with one wide V shaped bowl on a thin stem above one short base line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a sharper martini style glass instead of a rounded goblet bowl.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded wine glass when the bowl should not bulge into one curved goblet shape.
